summary: Frontend-only verification of redesigned Super Admin 'Bookings' page (/admin?tab=bookings). All 13 spec items from the review request pass end-to-end. Login via POST /api/auth/verify-otp with +919000000000 / 123456 / role=admin; token stored in localStorage 'azo_token'; page loaded and rendered 16 bookings. Status tabs show counts matching the GET /api/admin/bookings payload (Pending 1, Pending Payment 2, Searching 1, Assigned 1, Started 1, Completed 8, Paid 1, Cancelled 1, All 16); default tab is the first status (bk-tab-pending aria-selected=true, not All) and clicking bk-tab-all switches the row list — bk-count updates to 'View and manage customer bookings · 16 total bookings'. Summary cards bk-stat-total-bookings=16, bk-stat-pending=3 (pending+pending_payment=1+2), bk-stat-in-progress=3 (searching+assigned+started=1+1+1), bk-stat-completed=8, bk-stat-paid=1, bk-stat-cancelled=1 — all correct against counts. Search bk-search with 'zxczxczxc_nonexistent' triggers bk-empty with bk-clear-filters, which restores rows. bk-filter-status=completed narrows to 8 rows and clearing resets. Date menu bk-date opens all presets (bk-date-today, bk-date-yesterday, bk-date-7d, bk-date-30d, bk-date-month, bk-date-lastmonth, bk-date-custom, bk-date-all); bk-date-custom reveals bk-date-from / bk-date-to / bk-date-apply. Filter drawer bk-filters-btn opens bk-filter-drawer with all expected fields present: bk-adv-status/type/service/category/customer/partner/payment/min/max; typing 'unassigned' in partner + bk-adv-apply shows '1' active-count badge on Filters button and returns 8 unassigned rows; bk-adv-reset + apply clears the badge. Sorting bk-sort-amount toggles asc (first row ₹588.82) → desc (₹3,391.14). Pagination: bk-page-size=10 shows 'Showing 1–10 of 16'; bk-page-next → 'Showing 11–16 of 16'; bk-page-first returns to page 1. Copy: hover row, click bk-copy-{code} fires toast 'Booking code copied.' (sonner). View: bk-view-{code} opens bk-drawer with bk-drawer-timeline and bk-drawer-open-full button. Menu: bk-menu-{code} dropdown contains bk-menu-full-{code} (Manage reschedule/refund…). Selection: bk-select-{code} opens bk-bulk-bar with bk-bulk-export and bk-bulk-clear; bk-select-all shows '10 selected' (all page rows). Export: bk-export dropdown exposes bk-export-csv (filtered) and bk-export-all (all); bk-export-top is also present in page header. Mobile 390x844: row list renders as 10 mobile cards (bk-row-{code}), no document-level horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390), tabs horizontally scrollable (no-scrollbar container). No console errors observed on the Bookings route. The 'Turn on alerts' toast persists bottom-left/right but does not overlap any tested bk-* control.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingsPro.jsx is 181 lines and well-structured; UI is split cleanly into BookingsTable, BookingDrawer, FilterDrawer, DateRangeMenu, Badges and shared.js — total 591 LoC across the module, well under the 700 LoC threshold.

Filtering runs on the client over the full /admin/bookings payload. With only 16 bookings this is fine; at ~1k+ bookings this will become sluggish and the search/sort should either be moved server-side or memoized incrementally. Low priority given current scale.

advCount counts a.min/max only when !== '' but there's no numeric validation — if a user types 'abc' into bk-adv-min, Number('abc') is NaN and the comparison 'amount >= NaN' is false, so every row would be filtered out silently. Consider clamping to Number.isFinite before applying. Minor.

Date-range filter uses b.created_at as the only date field; the adv.date filter also uses created_at (not scheduled_at). The spec/UI copy says 'date' generically which is fine, but 'Date' column shows created_at — the drawer could offer a 'Date type' pick (created vs scheduled). Suggestion only.

Sort key uses String(b[sort.key] ?? '') for everything except amount; for 'created_at' this means lexicographic sort on ISO strings — correct for well-formed ISO but fragile if a timestamp lacks TZ. Non-blocking.

Pager.nums uses a Set to dedupe but will show at most 5 items (1, page-1, page, page+1, pages). On larger datasets this collapses middle pages via '…' which is good, but mid-range pages (e.g., page 5 of 20) will render only [1 4 5 6 20]. Acceptable minimalist pattern.

Row 'Copy' button is only visible on group-hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100). Keyboard-focus users can tab to it (focus:opacity-100 is set) but mobile touch cannot hover — fine because mobile MobileCard omits inline copy; the drawer header has a persistent Copy. OK.

exportCsv writes a Blob and clicks a transient <a>; works. However URL.revokeObjectURL(url) is called synchronously after a.click() which can race on some browsers before the download is committed — safer in a setTimeout(…, 0). Minor.

BookingDrawer's Timeline infers 'done' from ORDER[k] <= reached when the explicit timestamp is missing. For a 'cancelled' booking this correctly short-circuits to only mark pending_payment + cancelled as done. OK.

shared.js STATUS_TONE lacks tones for 'pending' / 'searching' / future statuses; tone() falls back to slate — status badge will still render but without colour semantics for unknown statuses. Not observed in current data (all statuses mapped).
SelectBox options use the 'service' column of uniq() with no truncation; a very long service name will stretch the status select. Minor.

FilterDrawer's bk-adv-partner uses case-insensitive includes except when value === 'unassigned' which flips to a presence check (!b.partner_name). This is undocumented in the input placeholder beyond 'or unassigned'; a partner literally named 'Unassigned' would be mis-matched to the presence check. Acceptable product tradeoff.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed test flows (13/13 spec items passed)

test_credentials: Admin +919000000000 role=admin OTP 123456 via POST /api/auth/verify-otp, token in localStorage 'azo_token'
seed_data_creation: None. The Bookings page is read-only listing; no bookings were cancelled/refunded/modified during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bookings redesign (BookingsPro + bookings/*) is fully functional with bk-* testids. Payload has 16 seeded bookings covering 8 statuses. The 'Turn on alerts' sonner toast appears bottom and can obscure the Pager row; use Escape/dismiss first before clicking page controls near the bottom edge. page.goto with wait_until='networkidle' times out at this URL because of a long-lived EventSource/websocket; use wait_until='domcontentloaded' and then wait_for_selector('[data-testid="bookings-page"]'). Clipboard copy requires context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) on the preview origin. BookingDrawer uses shadcn Sheet; closing is done via Escape or the X in the header. Row-level 'Copy' icon is hover-only on desktop — hover the row first, then click. bk-select-{code} and bk-select-all are shadcn Checkboxes — click them with force=True to avoid overlay interception.
